## Acquired methods can change actual inquiry

The [inquiry-interface continuation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/INQUIRY-INTERFACE-ARGUMENT.md) traces a further effect in existing [method-revision](METHOD-REVISION.md) controls. Two histories share the actual three-state process, resource arrival, misleading zero receipt and native prefix. Changing the retained method invokes the broader family, which requires four acquisition readings under the supplied uniqueness rule; a matched write clamp retains the narrower method, which requires three. Both later prediction tests succeed.

The native timing matters: the narrower method's forward test first coincides with the broader method's extra acquisition cycle. The broader complete history then adds one more action/read pair. This establishes consequence-dependent inquiry duration through a retained mechanism. It does not show that the contact repertoire formed, that the stopping rule was learned, or that the extra investigation was warranted.

The same study corrects a possible overreading of the older abstraction learner. Its acquired distinguishing suffix changes the diagnostic representation within an already declared all-word scope. Its primary fresh query sequence also matches fixed bounded enumeration; that sequence alone does not identify adaptive sampling. The stronger matched method control supplies the actual sampling effect.

Conservative expansion of an exact action/question interface has a different scope, as the [mathematical identity account](IMMANENT-MATHEMATICAL-IDENTITY.md) establishes. When inquiry changes old operations or their meaning, continuity must be reconstructed through the actual history and whichever correspondences are claimed to persist. The exact projection theorem does not apply merely because the labels remain.

The further target is formation or revision of the criterion for sufficient inquiry through the consequences of investigating. This is a named currently supplied relation, not a demand for another controller above every controller. The [primary comparison](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/INQUIRY-INTERFACE-COMPARATORS.md) provides a scoped test of contingent investigation; [review](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/INQUIRY-INTERFACE-REVIEW.md) preserves the distinction from warranted concern and new access. Existing result scopes and failed cases remain unchanged.
